data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Othmane means 'the one who supports the weak or the oppressed'. This name is derived from the name of the third Caliph of Islam, Othman ibn Affan, who was known for his strong support for the Muslim community during his time. The name Othmane carries the meaning “Supporter of the weak” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Othmane usually hope their child will grow to embody supporter of the weak and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Othmane carries a rich Islamic history and cultural significance. It is a reminder of the heroic actions of the third Caliph of Islam, Othman ibn Affan, who ruled after Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). During his time, he faced immense hardship and opposition from the enemies of Islam. Despite the trials and tribulations, he held strong to his faith and continued to support the Islamic community. This name has since become a symbol of strength, integrity, and unwavering support for the faith and its people.
data.spiritual_significance: SPIRITUALLY, the name Othmane invokes the spirit of compassion and empathy. It is a reminder that in life, we are called to support and uplift one another, especially those who are weak, oppressed, or in need. The name encourages us to be the change we want to see in the world, to strengthen our faith, and to remain steadfast in our convictions. It is a reminder that through our actions and support, we can make a positive impact on the world and bring people closer to the Creator.
